name: mimu-geonode-hard-to-reach-village-tract
notes:
Hard To Reach Village Tracts in Myanmar. The General Administration Department defines the Hard to Reach areas in three categories (Moderate, Hard, Very Hard)  according to road accessibility across seasons.

Order No. 44/219, 8 May 2019 by the Ministry of Planning and Finance

Original dataset title: Hard to Reach Village Tract May 2019
